items.title: The restriction of a flat module to an object of the site is flat

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that restricting a flat module along an object U of a ringed site preserves flatness. The proof takes an exact complex of modules on U, uses exactness of extension by zero together with flatness of the original module to conclude that the complex obtained by extending by zero after tensoring is exact, then applies the compatibility of extension by zero with tensor products and the fact that extension by zero is faithful to deduce exactness after tensoring over U, which is precisely flatness of the restriction (proof lines 4587-4603). H2: the transport of exactness through extension by zero and the use of its compatibility with tensor products is the substance.
